cat .tmp/r_empty.txt .tmp/r_neg.txt .tmp/r_big.txt .tmp/r_cat.txt | sort -u > .tmp/rejected.txt
echo "total_rejected_unique=$(wc -l < .tmp/rejected.txt)"
echo "total_data_rows=$(wc -l < $D)"
